title: Ask your llm to make a trailer for your game, this is what Codex came up for Ares Outpost!
author: Caninetechnology
selftext:
Every day I discover some new features that Openai/Anthropic dont even bother advertising. Not only can codex create a trailer on its own, it created all game marketing material including thumbnails, screenshots, profile pictures. Since the project has the context of the game it knows what aesthetic to make the artwork.

Thank you for reading all of this, if you want to try my addicting laneless tower defense game [https://francisstudio.itch.io/ares-outpost](https://francisstudio.itch.io/ares-outpost) , also discord with more dev stuff here [https://discord.gg/X7hcKTZNN](https://discord.gg/X7hcKTZNN)

comments.author: Jlannin
comments.body:
Similarly I used Claude Code to build me a capability I call 'Spotlight' - it's a whole tool with a UI - to record my game and produce marketing content from appstore screenshots to youtube trailers. It uses the same game engine as the real game - just orchestrated, a virtual screen (on my macmini using Better Display), and screen recording to capture the images and such.   It's not re-creating the game, it's using the game as the engine for recording what I want.  
  
You can read about it a bit here: 

[https://revealhaven.com/tech/spotlight](https://revealhaven.com/tech/spotlight)
